title: A flow of the team's work (flows/v1)
description: One small format for a flow: who took part (actors), what each did and when (steps, each with its evidence), who spoke to whom (edges, counted from the steps) and the gaps with nothing on record (pauses). Made by tools/flows-build.mjs from the record, or from a path of incident.storyteller@ (story/paths/*.md); drawn by app/flows/player.js. Documented in flows/README.md; the primitives agreed with story/primitives.md.

id.description: Permanent: the file is data/flows/<id>.json, the embed app/flows/embed.html?flow=<id>.

kind.description: wake: one agent's wake end to end; handover: one session to the next; night: one agent by its sessions; path: a path told by incident.storyteller@.

summary.description: One sentence: what the flow shows, with its counts and times.

experiment.description: Every flow is an experiment until said otherwise, and every view says so.

recipe.description: For a flow made by recipe: kind, agent, and n or at. The browser makes the same flow from the same record (app/flows/core.js).

source.description: For a path: the markdown file it was read from.

built_from.description: The tracked files the flow was made from.

record.description: The record read: head (the latest commit in it) and updated.

id.description: a-<agent> for an agent, s-<agent>-<n> for its nth session, p-<name> for a person, o-<name> for an outside body, t-<name> for a thing (a file, a page, a data set, a key).

icon.description: The shape drawn: person, agent, session, outside, page (a thing); the shape says the kind, never colour alone.

mark.description: Up to three letters inside the icon.

of.description: A session: the agent actor it belongs to.

drawn.description: Present when the time is not recorded and was drawn from a neighbouring fact; says how. Drawn steps are dashed in every view.

object.description: What: a commit's subject, a file, a page, a sentence; short.

to.description: The actors it is addressed to or acts on (an arrow in the view).

n.description: When one step stands for several (an hour's commits folded): how many.

updated.description: The time of the flow's last step (no clock: the same record gives the same bytes).

commit.description: The first 8 hex of a commit on dev.

file.description: A tracked file (or folder, ending in /).

note.description: When nothing is on record: says so.
